about: Owner-approved identity-audit exceptions (tools/identity-audit.mjs). Each one turns one specific C finding into B (never A) while every bound value still matches; otherwise the finding stands. Never applies to D, never to provisional seasons, never to any other finding. Approved 2026-10-05 for future enrichment; see docs/HANDOFF.md §16.

exceptions.reason: Star Wars: Visions is released in volumes; the curated label "Volume 1" is TMDB season 1 (same 2021-09-22 release, same nine shorts).
The curated label "Volume 2" is TMDB season 2, which TMDB itself names "Volume 2" (2023-05-04).
The curated label "Volume 3" is TMDB season 3, which TMDB itself names "Volume 3" (2025-10-29).
The stored date is the official Season 2 premiere, the TV film "The Siege of Lothal" (Disney XD, 2015-06-20); TMDB files it under Specials and starts season 2 on 2015-10-14.
Curated title kept by the owner; TMDB's title is "The Acolyte" and lists "Star Wars: The Acolyte" only as a US working title, which the audit otherwise ignores.

The curated date is Season 1's TLC premiere (Monday, Aug 9, 2021); the season first streamed on discovery+ from Feb 21, 2021 (Discovery's Jan 25, 2021 release), which is TMDB's season date. Both are real premieres; the TLC date is kept.
